name: toggle
useFor: Use for a two-state formatting or view option in a toolbar (Pin, Show receipts). Give icon-only toggles an aria-label. Use a switch for a setting that takes effect at once and a checkbox in forms.
constraints: A blue fill for the on state (that is the chosen tab)
A toggle that triggers an action
source: Extrapolated from the brand's keys (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css --bevel, --pressed)
title: Toggle
description: A key that stays down: a ghost or white key that sinks into the pressed well when on.
